document.title: Drive UI location from the URL hash
document.summary: `parseHash` and `serializeHash` encode the selection. `App` reads and writes `window.location.hash`. The README names the scheme.
document.why: [#78](source:s1) asks the UI location to live in the URL hash so serve and export share refresh and shared links.

sources.title: URL hash-based routing (serve + export)
sources.gist: Selection must leave sessionStorage. The hash is the route in serve and in a static export.

sources.label: PR #79
sources.title: Drive UI location from the URL hash
sources.gist: Closes #78 with a small hash scheme and tests for parse, serialize, and serve versus export URLs.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 13
sources.gist: Implement #78 on latest main after #75. Keep the hash thin so header and story hops write it too.

lookFor: [#78](source:s1) asks hash round-trips in serve and export. `urlWithSelection` keeps the path and only changes the hash.
[#78](source:s1) asks header `[` `]`, story hops, and lookFor jumps to update the hash. `App` writes on every `setSelection`.
[#78](source:s1) says stop using storage for the route. `readStoredSelection` is gone. Theme and viewed files still use storage.

groups.title: Hash scheme
groups.why: The App and the tests need one encoding for overview, groups, and buckets.
groups.summary: `parseHash` and `serializeHash` replace JSON sessionStorage. `hashWriteMode` replaces dead hashes and pushes live hops.
lookFor: Subtle. `hashWriteMode` replaces `#bogus` and `#group/gone`. A live hop from `#overview` to `#group/auth` pushes.

groups.title: Hash is the route in App
groups.why: [#78](source:s1) makes the hash the source of truth. This group is the only place that talks to `window.location`.
groups.summary: `App` restores from `location.hash` on load, writes with `replaceState` or `pushState`, and listens for `hashchange` and `popstate`.
lookFor: Opening a live `#group/<id>` skips the write. An empty hash `replaceState`s `#overview`.

groups.title: Serve and export share the hash
groups.why: [#78](source:s1) requires the same hash on `comprehende serve` and on a static export.
groups.summary: The README names the hash strings. The export test checks that serve and export return the same UI shell.

commits.subject: Drive UI location from the URL hash
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Replace sessionStorage as the review route with `#overview`, `#group/<id>`, and the bucket hashes so serve and static export share the same view on refresh and shared links.
